title: Review of c07's corrected fork readout for metabolic no-shell: on seed 4 every founder lineage survives to t=800 in the full world and in the ungated Dc 0.01, 0.03 and 0.005 twins
summary: Applied c03's fork.py (f0 = frame 25) to my own seed-4 labkit re-runs of the full metabolic world and of the ungated twins at Dc 0.01 and 0.03 (made for 20261025T1153-era reviews 20261025T1104-c11-review-shell-metabolism and the no-shell-needed review, packs copied here) and of my Dc=0.005 twin. Bodies and founders alive at frame 25 -> 100: full 27 -> 59, 27/27; Dc 0.01 44 -> 46, 44/44; Dc 0.03 27 -> 27, 27/27; Dc 0.005 45 -> 52, 45/45 (fork_s4.txt). This matches the corrected readout's pattern on seed 7 (full and slow-catalyst arms keep their founders; Dc 0.03 does not divide), so the corrected numbers stand.

observations.E: fork_s4.txt: founders alive at t=800: full 27/27, Dc 0.01 44/44, Dc 0.03 27/27, Dc 0.005 45/45

seeds_run.result: all founder lineages alive in all four arms

verdicts.limitation: These are my earlier seed-4 runs reused, not new runs made for this review. On seed 4 the full world loses no founders (24/26 on the author's seed 7).
